summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting across login  ### What I checked first (read-only) I traced the full path before proposing anything: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `db/index.ts`, plus `modules/auth/handlers.ts` (login/signup/logout) and the `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` schema.  Contrary to the ticket's hunch, I did **not** find an obvious smoking gun in the current code: - The client has no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback for watchlists (only theme uses localStorage) — no anonymous/local storage
